notes: Source side is the .psv written by parse_custbill_fixedwidth.sh over the pinned fixture set, loaded verbatim into ow_tp.bronze.custbill_legacy_baseline_psv - one row per psv line, keyed by the physical record number of the .dat line it came from. Target side is ow_tp.silver.custbill, recomputed by the Lakeflow pipeline from the raw .dat inputs. The comparison is psv_line, the whole legacy output line byte for byte. That is stronger than a field-by-field compare and it is the only sound one: the legacy's positional '|' split and silver's byte slices disagree by design on the delimiter-collision record (contract C-5.1), so a field-level diff there would be an artefact of the comparison rather than of the parse. No rule normalises whitespace: trailing spaces survive on bill_date, bill_amt and rec_type, so any rstrip here would hide a real difference.
